verdict.rationale: cubic documents automatic thread resolution that closes findings once the issue is fixed (cubic-docs-20), and it tracks per-PR which flagged issues were fixed (cubic-docs-16). Auto-fix running on 'every review of a pull request' (cubic-docs-66) implies a PR can get repeated reviews. The evidence never says that pushing new commits triggers a re-review, that the review is scoped incrementally to new changes, or that old comments are not reposted. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of push-triggered incremental re-review, evidence of deduplication or suppression of previously posted comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
